title: Flame Bold Variable Usage
slide_intent: Show how to control letter width deliberately so expressive composition can be repeated without arbitrary distortion.
strategic_value: A visible slider and letter-by-letter examples can help Burger King designers use the designed variable font rather than stretching static outlines.
demonstration: A software width control is shown at left; YUM and EAT appear as two vertical stacks with individual slider markers and values.
practical_value: Use the font’s width slider in InDesign or Illustrator and compare the six shown values as examples, not universal settings.

content_islands.name: Control explanation
content_islands.spec: Place the text and small software screenshot in the left column.

content_islands.name: YUM stack
content_islands.spec: Stack Y, U and M centrally with 298, 300 and 270 width markers.

content_islands.name: EAT stack
content_islands.spec: Stack E, A and T at right with 300, 286 and 300 width markers.

ingredient.name: Variable-width control
ingredient.role: Fit letterforms using their designed range.
ingredient.application: Adjust the width slider near the font menu; the displayed values illustrate these particular YUM and EAT compositions.
ingredient.scope: Historical 2020 partner guidelines, PDF produced January 2021. The full-page type restriction is stated on page 77; the numbers here are example axis settings, not dimensions or required values. Printed examples require BK legal trademark clearance and local legal review before use.

reference_purposes.Application: The page locates the width slider near font selection and supplies six worked letter settings.
reference_purposes.Expression: The two stacked words demonstrate width variation within the proprietary face.
